Matching real and imaginary parts with 2πik : excos⁡y=0,exsin⁡y=2πk. Because ex>0 , the first equation gives cos⁡y=0 , so y=π2+nπ,n∈Z. Hence sin⁡y=±1 , and we split by the sign of k : If k>0 , then sin⁡y=1 , so y=π2+2πm,m∈Z, and x=ln⁡(2πk). If k<0 , then sin⁡y=−1 , so y=3π2+2πm,m∈Z, and x=ln⁡(−2πk). Final Solution Set Therefore, {z=ln⁡(2πk)+i(π2+2πm),k>0, k,m∈Z,z=ln⁡(−2πk)+i(3π2+2πm),k<0, k,m∈Z.
